data.title: Juan gave Lulu and Georgia 1 star. Check out the full review...
data.content:
* * *

![Image 1: Rated 1 out of 5 stars](https://cdn.trustpilot.net/brand-assets/4.1.0/stars/stars-1.svg)

Jun 9, 2023

## [Rug is nothing like pics](https://www.trustpilot.com/reviews/648370a2706f837cb1fb7ada)
The rug we bought looks nothing like the photos. I just read other reviews where basically everyone complaints about the same, yet you keep selling it. Either take proper pictures or don't sell it. Your re-stocking fee is too high.

May 26, 2023

* * *

Reply from Lulu and Georgia

Jun 13, 2023

Hi Juan, Thank you so much your feedback, we are sorry to hear that you are not happy with your purchase. Our Trade team is happy to assist you with a free return pickup for the rug with our third party freight carrier, and issue a full refund. There aren't any restocking fees associated with all sizes of rugs as well, but please let us know if there’s anything else we can help with.
